title: Renshenjian decoction alleviates diabetes via HIF-1alpha/SPTLC2 pathway by targeting ceramide synthesis.
authors: Chen, Huien; Nong, Shifei; Huang, Hongwei; Liu, Zheyuan; Ao, Wenxing; Zhou, Ziyou; Xian, Minghua; Wang, Shumei; Liu, Peiyi
one_liner_zh: 该文研究中药复方通过HIF-1alpha/SPTLC2通路调节神经酰胺合成改善糖尿病，仅涉及分子对接且非蛋白质-DNA互作体系，与本课题无关。
abstract: ETHNOPHARMACOLOGICAL RELEVANCE: Renshenjian decoction (RSJ) is a traditional recipe for treating diabetes in an ancient Chinese medical book, composed of Puerariae lobatae Radix and Ginseng Radix. Despite its traditional use, the mechanism of RSJ in improving diabetes has not been elucidated. AIM OF THE STUDY: This research aimed to investigate the effects and underlying mechanisms of RSJ in treating diabetes. MATERIALS AND METHODS: Diabetic (T2DM) mice were induced using a high-fat diet coupled with streptozotocin injections. The effect of RSJ was assessed through biochemical and histopathological analyses of blood and liver samples to evaluate liver function and tissue damage in T2DM mice. The mechanism of RSJ in treating diabetes was explored using molecular docking, metabolomics, and molecular biology techniques. Additionally, the role of RSJ was further validated in T2DM mice treated with the HIF-1alpha stabilizer DMOG. RESULTS: RSJ could enhance insulin sensitivity and lower blood glucose and lipids in T2DM mice. These effects may be related to various components in RSJ, including puerarin, ginsenoside Rb1, and ginsenoside Re. Liver metabonomics revealed 57 differential metabolites in the model and RSJ groups, with 22 enriched pathways, predominantly related to sphingolipid metabolism. Furthermore, qPCR and Western blot results demonstrated that RSJ dramatically decreases the expression of HIF-1alpha and SPTLC2, as well as the ceramide content in the liver of diabetic mice. These results were partially reversed by the DMOG. CONCLUSION: RSJ can inhibit the expression of ceramide through the HIF-1alpha/SPTLC2 pathway, which helps to improve diabetes and diabetes-related dyslipidemia and liver injury.
abstract_zh: 民族药理学相关性：人参健汤（RSJ）是古代中医典籍中治疗糖尿病的传统方剂，由葛根和人参组成。尽管其传统应用广泛，但RSJ改善糖尿病的机制尚未阐明。研究目的：本研究旨在探讨RSJ治疗糖尿病的作用及其潜在机制。材料与方法：采用高脂饮食联合链脲佐菌素注射诱导糖尿病（T2DM）小鼠模型。通过血液和肝脏样本的生化和组织病理学分析，评估RSJ对T2DM小鼠肝功能和组织损伤的影响。利用分子对接、代谢组学和分子生物学技术探讨RSJ治疗糖尿病的机制。此外，在给予HIF-1α稳定剂DMOG处理的T2DM小鼠中进一步验证RSJ的作用。结果：RSJ能增强T2DM小鼠的胰岛素敏感性，并降低血糖和血脂。这些效应可能与RSJ中的多种成分有关，包括葛根素、人参皂苷Rb1和人参皂苷Re。肝脏代谢组学分析显示，模型组和RSJ组共有57种差异代谢物，富集到22条通路，主要涉及鞘脂代谢。此外，qPCR和Western blot结果表明，RSJ显著降低糖尿病小鼠肝脏中HIF-1α和SPTLC2的表达，以及神经酰胺含量。这些结果部分被DMOG逆转。结论：RSJ可通过HIF-1α/SPTLC2通路抑制神经酰胺的表达，从而有助于改善糖尿病及糖尿病相关的血脂异常和肝损伤。
